# mistershell_recording_store (Data Source)

Reads a MisterShell recording_store by ID or exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_recording_store" "example" {
  id = "123"
}

# Alternatively, resolve one exact name.
data "mistershell_recording_store" "by_name" {
  name = "recording-store"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Object ID. Specify either ID or an exact name; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Read-Only

- `backend` (String) Backend.
- `created_at` (String) Created at.
- `credential_id` (Number) Credential id.
- `credential_name` (String) Credential name.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `is_builtin` (Boolean) Is builtin.
- `params` (Dynamic) Params.
- `updated_at` (String) Updated at.
